description.html: This hide looks like a piece of a hollow, fallen log. The outside is rough, furrowed bark in warm orange-brown with greyish highlights, the ends are open, and the side has a round opening, like a hole left by a fallen branch.

A hollow log offers more than a plain cave. Your animal can pass through it, rest inside or look out through the side opening, and always has several ways out. Snakes love to squeeze through passages like this, and geckos and smaller lizards use the opening as a window to watch the terrarium.
The warm brown color fits forest terrariums with leaves and moss as well as drier setups with sand and bark.

You can partly bury the log in the substrate so it looks as if it fell many years ago, or lay it along the back glass and surround it with plants. Make sure it does not sit on unstable ground, since animals climb on it too. Check the inside regularly and wash it with warm water.
